description: Source code for counter management in an AUTOSAR platform, including functions for counter increment, retrieval, elapsed time calculation, and tick handling.

methods.name: IncrementCounter
methods.description: Increments the specified counter, with access and validity checks, and triggers alarm and schedule table checks.

methods.name: GetCounterValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specified counter, handling both hardware and software counters.

methods.name: GetElapsedCounterValue
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time between a previous counter value and the current, updating the reference value.

methods.name: OsTick
methods.description: Handles system tick interrupt, increments the tick counter, updates the counter, and checks alarms and schedule tables.

methods.name: GetOsTick
methods.description: Returns the current system tick count.

methods.name: Os_CounterInit
methods.description: Initializes alarms and schedule tables associated with counters.
